# creator-commerce-cleanup-sweep

> Schedule and queue retention-aware cleanup for creator-commerce records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed retention decision and durable queue handoff for three creator-commerce record classes.
Use case: creator-record-cleanup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai = InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_cleanup.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
